description: E3: the Hollow Titan's harness, the last giant king's, taken from the field after his fall and beaten down to a living giant at Last Hearth's forge - a crown-helm, the king's pauldrons, the oathbound cuirass, vambraces, the vigil greaves and a signet of his crown-iron. It stands as he stood: blows rock its wearer less, and what it strikes with it strikes heavily.

bonuses.name: Oath-bound
bonuses.text: Blows rock you 15% less (poise damage taken)

bonuses.name: The Last King's Harness
bonuses.text: Heavy blows strike 10% harder and what you hurl 25% harder
